receipt.public_excerpt: LLMs can be steered towards specific locations in the political spectrum through Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with only modest amounts of politically aligned data

evidence_items.explanation: Shows that fine-tuning can cheaply make a model stand out politically. The claim already exempts fine-tuning, and this study gives no accuracy-cost result. So it gives context, not a verdict.

unresolved_gaps: No study found that measures accuracy loss from political fine-tuning against an unsteered baseline.
The claim names no measure of 'standing out', so no result can be matched to it.
